summary.text: Paul Nichols is on the November ballot for Assembly District 32 on The Answer Party line.

According to his campaign website, he is an attorney, pastor and community leader in Queens who previously ran for governor of New York in 2022. Ballotpedia says he has not completed its Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Nichols is an attorney and community leader in Queens who has also worked as a pastor, and he ran for governor of New York in 2022.
The Queens Chronicle reported that he is an attorney who has previously worked for several elected officials in Southeast Queens.
